subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear OS permanently replace the dedicated Agent and Session pages with compact Home pickers while adding the `model-controls` Phone companion capability?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and proof-positive, but the user-facing navigation reduction and long-lived companion protocol are product/compatibility choices that automated review cannot make.

options.title: Accept the Home-first workflow
options.body: Merge after rebasing and exact-head Android checks if the Android owner wants Home to be the canonical place for agent, session, and model changes.

options.title: Keep dedicated context pages
options.body: Request a narrower iteration that preserves Agent and Session pages and adds only the intended Home affordance, if navigation discoverability is preferred.

options.title: Defer model controls
options.body: Land only the navigation consolidation and track model selection separately if the new companion capability needs more product discussion.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home-first workflow
recommendation.body: Merge after rebasing and exact-head Android checks if the Android owner wants Home to be the canonical place for agent, session, and model changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Assigned reviewer and recent author of the branch’s Android/Wear compatibility hardening.
